entities.name: Al-Azhar University
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Founded in 970 CE in Cairo as a center of Islamic learning, Al-Azhar is one of the world's oldest continuously operating universities and the foremost institution of Sunni Islamic scholarship. For over a millennium it has trained scholars, issued fatwas, and served as the authoritative voice on Islamic jurisprudence and theology.
